Band.Name: The Speed Freak
Band.BandBiographyText:
Martin Damm has been releasing records since 1990 under various project names, the most recurrent ones being Biochip C., The Speed Freak, and Search & Destroy. Starting off making German-style EBM techno, he soon became part of the Cologne school around Walker, and released on labels such as Monotone, Force Inc., and Dj.ungle Fever. After his increased popularity especially with the Dutch gabber scene in 1994 and 1995, Mokum and Shockwave became his home labels. His musical activities however stretch much further - tracks from his studio can be found on lots of different labels and on dozens of CD compilations. Apart from his further involvement in several labels such as Ozon (with Jammin' Unit), Napalm (plus its sublabels Agent Orange and Speedcore) and Anodyne (plus the defunct Biophobia), he is also available for live and deejay gigs. furthermore, he has started to produce his own videos and CD-ROM parts.

Part of what makes the music of Martin Damm interesting is his versatility. The tracks coming from his studio, Biosfear, stylistically stretch over the whole area of electronic dance music - going from power acid to breakcore, from drum & bass to happy gabber, from straight techno to dubby trip hop. Fans will rave about the squiggly 303 programming, the bouncy kickdrums and clattering breakbeats, the powerful and dense yet transparent overall sound, the wonderfully witty combinations and structures, the overwhelming wealth of amazing sound ideas and little melodies, and last not least the cynically cheesy organs and shameless sampling.

Band.Name: Airbase

Alias.@AliasProfile: Trance/Progressive DJ & producer from Gothenburg, Sweden. Brother of [a=André Söderlund]. Contact: jezper@airbasemusic.com  Discogs-unlisted old alias: Transic

Band.BandBiographyText:
In 1994 while visiting his relatives in Finland, a cousin introduced him to a music production software called Screamtracker. Jezper was so intrigued with this piece of software that he convinced his cousin to make a floppy disk copy of the software to bring with him home.

As a boy scout Jezper left for a weekend of camp school in 1995. At the closing party for that weekend, a DJ was playing some new kind of dance music previously unknown to Jezper. He just had to ask what this music was. He doesn't remember what the DJ said the style was called, but the DJ was kind enough to write down two of the tracks he had played on a piece of paper. Those two tracks were Age Of Love - Age Of Love and RMB - Matisse.

When Jezper came home he directly went to the record store to look these two tracks up. The store obviously didn't have any of them in stock, but they had a big catalogue you could use to look up records you'd like to import. He found three albums that he decided to just take the chance and order totally unheard. Those records were Emmanuel Top - Early Works, RMB - This World Is Yours and a compilation called Mayday - The Raving Society.

Finding instant love in this kind of music he went on to look up more artists that had featured on that Mayday compilation and also checking out other compilations that featured those artists. His collection of CDs with this music is by now very big. It stretches from Happy Hardcore, Rave Mission, Thunderdome, Reactivate, all the Mayday collections and many more.

While this transition in music taste was happening he went from Amiga to PC and found a new haven in the software Fasttracker. He stuck to this software until the end of 1999 even though he had mad some early Cubase training while studying video and radio production in school.

Four days into the new millenium Jezper moved from the swedish west coast city Gothenburg to the east coast city Stockholm, capital of Sweden, for a new job. With his first pay check he bought himself a brand new synth, a Yamaha CS2x. By that purchase, Jezper also decided to try and do some more serious producing to maybe one day sign something to a label. With this purchase he also had to leave the tracker based software behind and began working with Cubase.

A great number of tracks were made over the next year and a half and by that time a new software on the market started to make ripples online and his close friend Tommie couldn't stop talking about it. Believing hardware was the way to success, it took a while for Jezper to give this new software a chance. This software was Propellerheads Reason. And once he finally gave Reason a chance, realising its potential, things happened fast.

Within 6 months Jezper had produced and signed his first record; Airbase - Emotion and quickly started to sign new material to other labels as well. New to the scene, he ended up with new aliases for every label he signed with, so you might have heard his tracks even though you weren't aware of it. Some of his aliases used are Airbase, Scarab, Transic, Crimton, Jezper, Ozone, J, Jezper Soderlund, Rah, Mono, Moon, One Man Army, Parc, JLND and JZ.

Since this start, he's been signed to labels such as Black Hole, Platipus, Armada, Gesture Music, Fundamental, Intuition, Alphabet City, Afterglow and many more. He's released over 20 records and made over 50 remixes and has had great success with constant support from the absolute elite of todays trance Djs. He co-wrote the Sensation Anthem Belgium 2004 together with his brother André (First & Andre - Widescreen).

With all the success as a producer, DJ bookings started to drop in. Luckily Jezper was prepared after spending 4 years as a pub/bar DJ. Getting bookings related to his releases gave Jezper the opportunity to play the music he really loves instead of serving old 70'ies disco hits.

He's had the pleasure of playing in places like America, England, Israel, Ibiza, Finland, Poland, Holland, Scotland, Rumania, Latvia, Estonia, Norway, Denmark, Czech Republic, Slovenia, Hungary, Switzerland and many other places. He's been playing great venues and parties like Trance Energy, Mysteryland, Privilege Ibiza, Passion UK and O2 Arena London among others and many more to come.

Jezper's committed to give his all as a producer and DJ and has already come a long way. But like most people, he wants more, so one thing is definitely for sure; Jezper is here to stay and he's gonna do whatever it takes to please his fans.

Band.Name: Armin van Buuren
Band.BandBiographyText:
Armin van Buuren has been named number one in the prestigious DJ Top 100 poll twice in a row, in 2007 and 2008– voted for by over 350,000 people across the world, and an indication of his prolific output over the 10 years he’s been dj’ing and producing. Being the official World’s Most Popular DJ is just one of his many achievements, but the driving force behind his success is an overriding passion for dance music.

2008 began with the success that the number one DJ seems to attract; he was awarded with the prestigious Buma Cultuur Pop Award in January. This was followed by being voted as the Best Trance Artist in the Beatport Music Awards in March; judged on the musician’s artistic achievements, national and international success, it is evident that Armin van Buuren has become one of the decade’s most influential trance acts.

Even a basic list of recent successes reads like a lifetime of work: ‘Best Album’ for artist album ‘Shivers’ at both the Dutch Release Dance Awards and the prestigious Edison Awards; ‘Best Compilation’ for ‘A State Of Trance’, in 2006, claiming the ‘Best European DJ’ award in 2007 and ‘Best Mix Radio Show’ at the Miami Winter Music Conference in 2006 and 2007, for radio show ‘A State Of Trance’ – now broadcasting on a massive 40 FM stations as well as satellite and internet radio, with over 26 million listeners a week; a 5th year residency in Ibiza at Amnesia and over 50,000 downloads every week from podcasting high end chart-bothering positions all over the world for singles, albums and compilations , with single ‘Rush Hour’ used as the theme tune to the UEFA European Youth Championship; the #1 entry in the Dutch album charts with his artist album ‘Imagine’, the #1 entry of the DVD registration of ‘Armin Only ‘ Imagine’ – the landmarks just keep coming!

Band.BandBiographyText:
Lisa Lashes (born Lisa Dawn Rose-Wyatt in Holbrooks, Coventry, England), is a leading English hard dance DJ.

An established and popular DJ in the UK hard dance scene, Lisa Lashes was one of the pioneers of UK hard house, a genre that was developed in the UK during the 1990s. Also known as the Queen of Hard House, Lashes plays styles including hard house, hard trance, psychedelic trance and techno.

Lashes formed The Tidy Girls with fellow female UK DJ Anne Savage. Now, under new management, she is working more or less without a regular DJ'ing partner. Lashes plays mainly in England, but also plays around the world including U.S., Republic of Ireland, Canada, South Korea, South Africa, Japan, Australia and China. Lashes is part-resident in Ibiza during the summer season, with her own Lashed in Ibiza nights at Eden nightclub.

Artist.ArtistBio: Timo was born in 1980 in Vantaa, Finland. Timo has been making music starting from his early teenage years in 1993. Back then he used a program called Protracker on the Amiga 1200. A few years later in 1996 he sold his Amiga and moved on to the PC with FastTracker 2, since 4 channels weren't enough. After 4 active years in the tracker scene, he decided it's time to move forward. In 2001 he was introduced to Jeskola Buzz and from then on he has been using it for producing music.

Teppo was born 1984 in Lappeenranta, Finland. Teppo has been making music starting from 1998 when he got his first computer. Teppo started making music with programs called Modplug Tracker and Scream Tracker. A few years later he changed to a program called Fruity Loops. It wasn't enough to Teppo and he decided to try a program called Reason. In 2002 Teppo was making music with Reason for a couple of years.Later he decided to try a program called Cubase. And today his primary program is Cubase with many VSTi's.

Band.BandBiographyText:
Bluebear Project got started in April 2007 in Lappeenranta when Timo was visiting Teppo. They had previously known each other through messenger and IRC but during the spring 2007 they started getting to know each other in real life as well. They decided to start trying to make some tunes together with Teppo's laptop. Back then it was just for fun. Summer went by, things were quiet but in August 2007, during another weekend session, the boys came up with a tune called Colours of Life. They were both satisfied with it and it eventually became their first proper tune made together.

Continuing their adventures in a fictional game world, they are sure to score some major club hits during their career.

Band.Name: Tragida
Band.BandBiographyText:
Tragida is Dario Lupo from Salerno, Italy. He started to produce Trance 6 years ago at home, with a bad computer and Fruity Loops. First he produced something commercial dance, he didn't know about the existence of the trance, when someday he listened Gouryella - Ligaya to the internet and discovered this new (for him) musical genre. In that period Tragida started to produce trance.

Over the years he gained experience, and gained the opportunity to join a new fresh label 'Emotive Sounds'. There his first release Saint Rush - Pyro (Tragida Remix) has attracted the attention of many peoples and radios, one of those is M2O Italian Radio, on Zero DB by Mazza & Martinelli.

After that, he released his first single, joined some new labels and created new aliases (first are Likuida and Afterstar, with those he produced some singles and remixes). In 2007 he joined DAIF Records, a Sweden label managed and runned by Joakim Daif & Aimee B, where now he's resident and Royal Tek Records managed and runned by Fabio Batti. He released a new single called My Pinky Lady dedicated to his girlfriend (his permanent font of inspiration) and a lot of remixes (Legendary Theme, After The Sunset, Life etc.) Now, Tragida has many different aliases and collabs, like Aerodive with Joakim Daif, a project between him and Likuida project, and he's producing a lot of new tunes to make people happy and dancing!

Band.BandBiographyText:
Since Guyver burst onto the hard dance scene in 2002 he has been a major influence on many producers and djs, inspiring the hard trance sound which is now extremely popular in the scene.

His real name is Guy Mearns, and his rise to stardom started when he was 17 and sent a demo into Tidy Trax, and they instantly snapped him up as a producer and dj. Since then he has had many successful productions, with quite a few reaching 'classic' status, probably most notably "Man on The Moon" and "Serious Sound".

Guyver is well known and well respected all around the hard dance scene, and he has a fan base that extends to Japan, South Africa, Canada and even Australia.

On the dj front, Guy has rocked clubs all around the world, playing at clubs in Canada, USA, Australia, Japan, South Africa, Norwary, Holland, Spain and New Zealand. His diary remains busy, playing at clubs regularly in the UK and Abroad, never failing to hit a chord with the crowds and delivering some truely breath-taking music.

Band.Name: Spugedelic Ultrawaves
Band.BandBiographyText:
Spugedelic Ultrawaves, a prominent figure in the world of Finnish Psytrance and Suomisaundi, was born on the 23rd of September, 1974, in the serene city of Tuusula, Finland. Known by several aliases throughout his career, including Rosvo-Roope, Sedät Perseestä, Hoikka Tunkio, Rujo Kukko, Lokinpaska, Hanurin Soittaja, Happo-Sepi, and Seppo Taalasmaa, he is most commonly recognized as Spugedelic Ultrawaves.

His musical journey began early, with a particular affinity for electronic music and DJing. Sepi Reinikainen, as he was born, developed a unique sound that would later become synonymous with the Finnish Psytrance genre. His talent behind the decks and in the studio led to a prolific career, spanning decades and leaving an indelible mark on the electronic music scene.

Spugedelic Ultrawaves's innovative approach to sound design, coupled with his masterful blending of traditional Finnish melodies with modern psychedelic trance rhythms, has earned him a dedicated following worldwide. His performances are known for their high energy and immersive quality, making every event a truly unforgettable experience.

Today, Spugedelic Ultrawaves continues to push the boundaries of electronic music, inspiring a new generation of artists and fans alike. His commitment to his craft and his unwavering passion for music make him one of Finland's most celebrated DJs and producers in the realm of Psytrance and Suomisaundi.

Band.BandBiographyText:
Blondiorkesteri is a Finnish Psytrance music group, known for their unique blend of Suomisaundi and electronic dance music. The band was formed in 1999 and has since gained a dedicated following within the Finnish music scene. Their eclectic sound and energetic performances have helped to solidify Blondiorkesteri's place as one of Finland's most innovative and influential musical acts.

The group is comprised of three talented women, Susanna Niemelä, Heidi Immonen, and Sarah Stevens. Susanna, a native of Espoo, Finland, serves as the Producer and Vocalist for the band. Born on July 23, 1978, she brings her distinctive voice and passion for music to the group. Heidi Immonen hails from Hyvinkää, Finland, and lends her skills as a DJ and Producer to the band. She was born on May 27, 1982, and her expertise in crafting captivating beats has played an integral role in the group's success. Sarah Stevens, a Helsinki native born on May 12, 1976, is responsible for managing public relations and overseeing engineering tasks within the band.

Throughout their career, Blondiorkesteri has adopted various aliases, showcasing their versatility and ability to experiment with different sounds. Some of these include Hypokontrabasso, Reefer Warriors, Spugedelic Babes, Lutkaputka, The Pilluminatic Cunts, Suurperhe, Tytönrutkut, Pissikset Kännis, Enigmatic Whorez, Ihkudaa Beibet, Bambilampi, Silmärilli, Girls From Lapland, Helsinki Bitches, Loop Hole, Pollen Posetiivi, Konitohtorisihteerit, Susanna vs Heidi, and many more.

Blondiorkesteri's music is characterized by its energetic beats, captivating melodies, and powerful lyrics that reflect the group's unique perspective on life and society. Their ability to seamlessly blend various genres has allowed them to create a truly distinctive sound that continues to resonate with fans both within Finland and beyond its borders. As they continue to evolve and push the boundaries of their musical style, Blondiorkesteri remains a shining example of the power of creativity and passion in the world of music.

Niko Nurminen, better known by his stage name Nikke Nipottaja, is a Finnish electronic music producer and DJ. He is best known for his work in the genres of psytrance and suomisaundi.

Nurminen began his musical career in the early 2000s, releasing several singles and EPs on various independent labels. In 2008, he founded his own label, Uraltone Records, through which he has released most of his subsequent work.

In recent years, he has become increasingly active as a purveyor of Finnish trance culture, running the popular blog Psychedelic Finns and hosting the radio show Suomi Sound System on Bassoradio.

Band.BandBiographyText:
Leipomon Posse is a Finnish Psytrance group, known for their unique and captivating sound that blends elements of Suomisaundi with other sub-genres. The band consists of four talented members: Erkki Seinäkello, Henkka Loossi, Anni Heinonen, and Riikka Reivilä. Each member brings their own distinctive style to the group, making them a force to be reckoned with in the world of electronic music.

Erkki Seinäkello is an accomplished DJ and producer hailing from Espoo, Finland. Born on April 11th, 1979, Erkki has been instrumental in shaping the band's sound and has contributed to numerous albums and singles over the years. His experience and expertise have helped solidify Leipomon Posse as a leading force in the Finnish Psytrance scene.

Henkka Loossi is another key member of the group, serving as both a DJ and producer. Born on April 4th, 1975 in Tampere, Finland, Henkka has been instrumental in creating the band's signature sound. His passion for music and his ability to blend different styles seamlessly make him an essential component of Leipomon Posse.

Anni Heinonen is a talented vocalist and keyboardist from Vantaa, Finland. Born on December 30th, 1985, Anni adds a unique touch to the band's music with her captivating voice and impressive keyboard skills. Her contribution to the group has helped Leipomon Posse stand out in the competitive world of electronic music.

Lastly, Riikka Reivilä serves as both a dancer and vocalist for the group. Born on August 16th, 1981, Riikka brings her incredible energy and performance skills to the stage, making Leipomon Posse's live shows truly unforgettable experiences for their fans.

In addition to their main alias, Leipomon Posse has also been known by several other names, including Signals Of Psyke, Progeruukki (Psychedelic / Progressive Psytrance), Koinsyömä Lepakko, Marvel Comic Talent, Mursu ja Apina, Pöytälaatikon Jämäbiisit, Napalm Bitch (Hardcore / Speedcore), Pollen Sukkahousu, Jolly Jolkottajat, Jullin Iso Kulli, Pure Nyrjähdys, The Setämies, and The Bass Jumpers (Hard Dance / Hard House).

Leipomon Posse's unique blend of Finnish Psytrance and Suomisaundi has earned them a dedicated fan base and widespread recognition within the electronic music community. As they continue to create groundbreaking music and mesmerizing performances, Leipomon Posse is sure to remain an influential force in the world of electronic dance music for years to come.

Band.BandBiographyText:
Aarniometsä is a Finnish psytrance duo consisting of Susanna Aarnio and Mikko Rissanen. Their music is characterised by its hypnotic, trance-like rhythms and psychedelic soundscapes.

Susanna Aarnio was born on 22nd July 1980 in Nurmijärvi, Finland. She began her musical career as a drummer in a number of underground rock bands before turning her attention to electronic music in the late 1990s. Her first solo album, "Kohti Tuhoa", was released in 2000 and established her as one of the most innovative and exciting new voices in the Finnish electronic music scene.

Mikko Rissanen was born on 20th February 1975 in Hyvinkää, Finland. He started out as a DJ in the early 1990s, playing dark ambient and industrial techno at clubs and parties around Helsinki. In 1996 he began making his own music, using mainly computer-generated sounds and samples. His first solo album, "Viimeinen virsi", was released in 1998.

Aarniometsä was formed in 1998 when Susanna and Mikko met at a party and discovered their shared love of psychedelic trance music. They quickly began writing and performing together, forging their own unique style of Finnish psytrance which they have continued to develop over the past two decades.

Loken's career began not only as a producer and vocalist but also as a model and actress, with roles in movies such as "Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines." However, her passion for music has always been her driving force. Her unique sound has earned her a dedicated fanbase across the globe, making her one of the most influential figures in electronic dance music today.

Loken's music is characterized by its energetic beats, powerful melodies, and deep emotional resonance that connect with listeners on a profound level. Her live performances are legendary, as she transcends the boundaries between artist and audience, creating unforgettable moments of shared ecstasy and connection.

Despite her successful career in music, Loken remains humble and dedicated to her craft. She continues to push the envelope, exploring new sounds and styles, and inspiring a new generation of electronic music producers and performers. Her story is one of determination, creativity, and an unwavering love for music, making her an icon in the world of dance music and beyond.

Band.Name: Above & Beyond
Band.BandBiographyText:
Above & Beyond are undoubtedly one of the most exciting talents in the global dance music scene today. Their genre-defining productions - often released on their own Anjunabeats label - have become an essential tool for the world's leading DJ's and have set the benchmark for the new generation of trance producers. Above & Beyond - aka Jono Grant, Tony McGuinness and Paavo Siljamäki - have recorded under a number of different aliases including Aalto, Free State, Nitromethane, Oceanlab, P.O.S and Tranquility Base.

Above & Beyond came together in 2000 originally to complete a remix of Chakra's club classic "Home" for WEA.

Jono Grant and Paavo Siljamäki had met at Westminster University and kicked off the Anjunabeats label in summer 1999 with 'Anjunabeats Volume 1', a massive club track which gained support from Pete Tong, Oakie and P.V.D.

Alerted to the pair by his brother Liam, producer Tony McGuinness called in Jono and Paavo to help him complete the Chakra remix while he was still working at Warners. They plucked the name Above & Beyond from a web page belonging to an American motivational trainer called Jono Grant which was stuck on the wall of the studio. Although they were unknown at the time, the Above & Beyond remix of Chakra 'Home' was picked over remixes by Rob Searle and Tilt to be the A side mix, and after plays on Pete Tong reached number one in the UK club charts.

In 2002 the boys began their DJ career in earnest, making their debut in Japan in front of 8,000 crazy Tokyo clubbers, on a bill featuring Ferry Corsten and DJ Tlesto. Pretty soon Above & Beyond were DJ'ing all over the globe, with residency at UK club Passion, dates for Gatecrasher in the UK and abroad, appearances at Godskitchen and tours of Canada, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Sweden, Denmark, Estonia, Russia and the USA.

Kerrostalokyttääjä is a renowned name in the realm of Finnish Psytrance and Suomisaundi music. The unique identity behind this intriguing title is none other than Riikka Aaltonen, a charismatic and talented artist born on 14th December 1983.

Born and raised in the verdant landscapes of Finland, Riikka was always deeply moved by its myriad of moods and rhythms, which echoed through her early music tastes. Her fascination with the pulsating energy of trance music led her to explore its various sub-genres, eventually leading her to discover her true calling within the realm of Psytrance and Suomisaundi.

Suomisaundi, also known as ‘Finnish sound’, is a style of freeform psychedelic trance that originated in Finland around the mid-1990s. It holds a unique space in the Trance genre with its complex and quirky soundscapes, breaking away from the conventional structures of mainstream electronic music. This genre provided a perfect canvas for Riikka's artistic expression, leading to the birth of Kerrostalokyttääjä.

Under the pseudonym Kerrostalokyttääjä, Riikka began channeling her creative energy into producing music that is described as distinctly Finnish, youthful, and intense. Her tracks are layered with atmospheric nuances, infused with raw energy and often feel like a spontaneous burst of creativity, which is a hallmark of the Suomisaundi style.

Riikka's work as Kerrostalokyttääjä has not only gained her fame within the Finnish music scene but has also put her on the global map. Her unique approach to music-making has allowed her to cultivate an international fan base of people who appreciate the unconventional nature of her sonic creations.

Furthermore, Kerrostalokyttääjä symbolizes Riikka’s connection with the audience through her music. Her choice to use a distinctive Finnish title represents her deep-rooted attachment to her homeland and her intent to share its unique cultural perspective through her work. The passion and authenticity resonating through Kerrostalokyttääjä’s music make Riikka Aaltonen a shining beacon in the Psytrance and Suomisaundi world.

Riikka continues to innovate as Kerrostalokyttääjä, constantly pushing the boundaries and keeping the Finnish Psytrance and Suomisaundi scene alive and thriving, echoing her love for music and dedication to her craft.

Band.Name: Far Too Loud
Band.BandBiographyText:
The rise of Far Too Loud within the breakbeat scene so far has been nothing short of impressive. With each release they have received a bigger response and reached a wider audience, ensuring no Breaks DJs box is without one of their records. Snapping up the Best Single award at Breakspoll 2007, only a year and a half after their first release, confirmed that these boys are serious players, especially as they were up against the some of most elite artists in the scene!

Far Too Loud began life as three students on one of the worlds leading sound engineering courses sharing an interest in electronic dance music, particularly the breakbeat sound which was going through a huge surge in popularity at the time. Armed with a solid knowledge of the technical side of music making and all hailing from strong musical backgrounds, it did not take long for the team to hone their productions skills. Summer 2005 saw the lads crash onto the scene with their debut release Whole Lotta Hate on Aquaskys 777 label, a collaboration with the mighty Ctrl Z. This received massive support including Radio 1 airplay and was soon followed by singles on established labels Broke and Funkatech, all to similar acclaim. In 2006 a string of releases and remixes firmly established Far Too Loud in the scene and gained the respect of an expanding audience. These included collaborations with rapidly rising stars and Funkatech label mates Specimen A.

Band.Name: 2 Bad Mice
Band.BandBiographyText:
Formed in 1991, 2 Bad Mice (the name originating from The Tale of 2 Bad Mice by Beatrix Potter) are widely credited as among the first U.K. hardcore acts to begin heavily incorporating breakbeats into the style. Consisting of members Sean O'Keeffe, Simon Colebrooke and producer Rob Playford (who also owns Moving Shadow records), 2 Bad Mice were a staple on the early- to mid-'90s hardcore scene, and were instrumental in the music's steady mutation into jungle/drum'n'bass.

The group's influential approach to sampled beats -- cutting them up into shards of rhythm and rearranging them in novel combinations (first appearing in mature form on the 1992 hit "Bombscare") -- is generally considered the blueprint from which jungle's characteristic manipulation of breaks was assembled.

Although 2 Bad Mice for the most part stopped producing as the hardcore scene began to wane (Playford focusing his energy on Moving Shadow, now one of the largest and most influential jungle labels), a best-of compilation of the group's work appeared on the American Sm:)e Communications label in 1995. Playford continues to record as a member of Metalheadz (together with namesake label owner Goldie), while O'Keeffe and Colebrooke have recorded sporadically under different names.

The band quickly gained popularity in Finland's underground psytrance scene for their innovative sound, which combined elements of traditional Finnish folk music with pulsing hypnotic beats. Their debut album Kauas Pois Kotimaasta ("Far from Home"), released in 2001, was an instant hit with Finnish ravers and established them as one of the leading lights of the Suomisaundi ("Finnish sound") movement.

Since then, Mutakarvakuono have continued to push boundaries with their unique brand of psytrance, releasing five more albums and performing at some of the biggest festivals in Europe and Asia. They show no signs of slowing down anytime soon – catch them live if you can!

He met Pöyhönen in 1998, and they formed Galactic Disco the following year. The duo released their debut album, Kohti tähtiä, in 2000, which was a huge success in Finland, reaching number one on the Finnish Albums Chart.

Galactic Disco has been a popular live act in Finland, and have performed at a number of festivals, including the Rovaniemi Festival, the Oulu Music Video Festival, and the Kuopio RockCock Festival.

Alias.@AliasProfile: Psy-Trance project from Germany

Frankfurt based DJ & producer Oliver Lieb is involved in the production of electronic music since 1988.  With more than 250 singles and albums including remixes for Faithless, Moby, Snap, Yello, Human League, Mory Kante, Utah Saints to name a few,  he made it in the premier leage of international producers and keeps surprising and amazing people with his extraordinary sounds and diversity.  At the age of 14 he started playing bass in several Funk/Soul/Jazz bands. Oliver also got in touch with electronic music (Pink Floyd, Kraftwerk,Yello, Jean-Michel Jarre) and discovered a new and an endless horizon of expressing himself. In late 1989 Oliver’s first record FORCE LEGATO “System” got released by Dorian Gray resident DJ Torsten Fenslau on his Abfahrt label. The single gained great worldwide reactions and almost hit the official German charts.  In the years to follow Oliver released everything in the electronic genres from downtempo and chill-out to hard experimental techno and trance. His project Spicelab on Sven Väth’s legendary Harthouse label established a platform for his highly appreciated sounds, which developed into one of the most important projects of the label including the release of three full length album releases.  Oliver never wanted to focus on just one specific genre he simply created several pseudonyms for each of his different styles. His LSG and Paragliders releases on Superstition Rec. are still considered as one of the most influencing and timeless trance projects and were developed for more than 10 years and 5 Albums. His maxis and albums got licensed on Hooj Choons, Yoshitoshi, Platipus, Duty Free, Magic Muzic and many others. After leaving Superstition in 2004 it was time for doing something new especially since the whole music scene went through big changes and somehow redefined itself.   After locking himself into his studio to create new sounds and going into all kind of different directions Oliver announced the start of his own label “Maschine” in summer 2005 which is distributed worldwide by “Neuton” and online exclusively through Beatport and released his first single “Solieb - Circus Maximus” in July. The reactions were great and two more maxis followed until the end of 2005. Maschine is about to turn into a main source for high quality forward electronic music and grabs more and more peoples attention.  In 2007 Oliver started a new company doing mastering and cutting vinyl. After all this was a logic step since he is known for a very high sound standard on his own productions and so he added some high end analog mastering gear to his studio to guarantee sound quality enhancement also for his clients. After the endless process of planning, constructions and moving in to the new studio and finally focusing on the new company he took a bit of a break from producing and djing - also to focus on a new sound and directions.  In 2010 Oliver started a new label Solieb Digital.

Band.Name: Sophie Sugar
Band.BandBiographyText:
'The UK's Foremost Female Trance Producer' - DJ Mag

Sophie Sugar is one of the shining stars of the UK trance scene. An established international DJ in her own right and now making waves around the world as a talented and exciting new producer, it is easy to see where this young lady is heading in 2008.

Sophie was always a music lover - playing the piano for 8 years and collecting records from the tender age of 6! In her teens, she became involved in the club scene and fell in love with trance music. After experimenting with mixing she realised she was hooked and in 1999 began DJing.

Over the next few years Sophie spent time developing her own sound, playing across the UK and in Ibiza, and in 2004 was delighted to win the prestigious Gallery/DJ Magazine DJ competition.

In 2004, Sophie began developing her production skills and throughout 2005 and 2006 released the hugely successful tracks 'Call of Tomorrow' and ‘Isis', both of which received support from many of the world's top DJs including Paul Van Dyk and Armin Van Buuren.

In 2006, Sophie's career went from strength to strength. After being nominated by Mixmag for the Trance Awards, she spent the year playing to a growing worldwide fan base with events in Canada, Morocco, Abu Dhabi, China, Europe and leading UK nights such as the Gallery, Serious and Passion.

In 2007, 'Fallen Too Far' became a worldwide smash hit after being signed to Armin Van Buuren's trance label Armada. The track received heavy support from the world's A list trance DJs and was featured in top 10 download charts on numerous dance music download websites.

This was followed with 'Day Seven', which Armin chose to feature on ‘A State of Trance 2007', 'Sense of Connection' and Sophie's very own interpretation of the Art of Trance anthem 'Madagascar'. All tracks were hugely successful, further enhancing Sophie's reputation as an exciting new producer with djs and fans worldwide.

As a DJ, Sophie continued to spread her melodic sounds across the world, travelling to many new countries including an incredible 10 date tour of Indonesia. She received continued support from the dance music press throughout the year including being featured as One To Watch by Mixmag.

In 2008, Sophie's name looks set to rocket with events already confirmed around the world including a 4 date tour of Australia and New Zealand in May. Look out for several new productions including Sophie's incredible new track, 'Redemption', already being supported by Armin Van Buuren and due for release in June.

With her own distinct brand of driving, uplifting trance, both in her productions and DJ sets, it's clear to see where this young lady is heading.

Frederik Soderstrom and Sina Morshed Solouk are the Evil Minded Producers behind the awesome live techno assault known as Devilfish. The Devilfish collaboration began 3 years ago after the two DJs met in Greece and decided to return to their native Sweden to conquer the world of techno.

From their first ever studio production, "Strawberry Fields" and debut album "Freakshow", right through to the instant classic "Manalive" and the new album "Techwise and Otherwise", Devilfish have been prolific producers of solid, slammin' techno and innovators of their very own Evil Minded sound. Devilfish tracks and remixes have occupied the crates of major techno taste-makers across the world including Luke Slater and Joey Beltram, and their track "Manalive" was recently licensed to a mix CD by the legendary Carl Cox. 

The Devilfish duo has also earned an extensive range of remix credits for such high profile artists as Trevor Rockliffe, Thomas Schumaker and La Familia, and their remix of Andrew McLauchlin's "Love Story" has dominated dancefloors worldwide for its fusion of hard-edged techno beats with funky percussion. 

The Devilfish sound is best described as funky and hard techno designed for the dancefloor, and represents sophisticated studio production techniques and an uncanny ear for quality drum loops and effects. The Devilfish collaboration combines the resources of two extremely talented producers in their own right, as both Frederik and Sina record for numerous solo projects and other collaborations under different monikers. 

Together Sina and Frederik are also responsible for the techno madness created by Intergalactic Phonk (on Frequent), the funky house grooves of SF Express and Pimp Squad (on Boo Records) and for the dark, evil electro sounds of CFA (on Meltdown Communications). Through their innovative recordings within these and other projects, Devilfish are constantly pushing the barriers of traditional techno. The complex loops and effects created by the Devilfish duo are continuously evolving and consistently funky.

The two Evil Minded Swedish producers continue to release a range of diverse and innovative, but always slammin' and funky tracks through Bush Records and its offshoots Boo and Meltdown Comunications. After a successful Australasian tour in early 2001, Devilfish have returned to Europe to continue their solid studio production and to take their awesome live show on tour across the world.

Born and raised in Finland, Noora displayed an early inclination towards music. Her unpredictable melodic explorations took her through various genres, but it was in Psytrance and Suomisaundi that she found her niche. Noora's explorations within these genres led to the creation of Lilith, a unique and important presence on the Finnish Psytrance and Suomisaundi scene since its inception.

Lilith's power lies in its enchanting use of hypnotizing beats, laced with mesmerizing atmospheric elements drawn from Finnish folklore and mythology. Combining richly layered soundscapes and exotic beats, Lilith's music has garnered international attention, drawing listeners into a mystical, unparalleled auditory experience. Noora's vigor to maintain the essence of her cultural roots through her music has bestowed upon Lilith a unique identity distinguishing it from its contemporaries.

With Lilith, Noora has created a well-respected project within the Psytrance community and beyond. Noora has consistently pushed the boundaries of her chosen genres. She has gained recognition not just for her innovation and risk-taking but also for her dedication to her craft and her profound respect for her cultural roots. Her passion for maintaining authenticity while pushing the limits of her sound is an inspiration for emerging artists in the Psytrance and Suomisaundi community.

Despite all the global recognition, Noora remains an enigmatic figure, allowing Lilith's music to take center-stage. Over the years, the burgeoning artist's talent shines through Lilith's discography, translating her personal stories and experiences into atmospheric, sonic epics that connect with listeners on a universal level. Noora's musical journey as Lilith is far from over, as she continues to innovate and elevate Finnish Psytrance and Suomisaundi to new heights.

In 2005 Will unleashed ‘Timeless,’ a vocal monster that went on to be one of the tunes of the year, featuring on Armin’s 2005 ASOT Yearmix compilation and Gatecrasher’s Classics 2 compilation. He was subsequently tipped by Mixmag as ‘One to Watch’ and gained the coveted ‘Future Hero’ status.  2005 was also the year that Will graduated university with a 2:1 in Event Management and a 1st in his dissertation ‘The changing face of the UK super-club’. Upon submitting his work and CV to Gatecrasher, Simon Raine, founder of the world’s most famous trance club appointed Will in charge of the promotions and marketing for their flagship club in Sheffield; Gatecrasher One. Will went on to run sell out events with the likes of [a=Armin van Buuren], [a=Ferry Corsten], [a=Roger Sanchez], [a=Above & Beyond] and [a=Erick Morillo]. A residency later followed, which saw will feature alongside the biggest names in the world, and further established him as one of the leading UK DJ’s, with a fantastic ability to play warm up or peak time sets.  Not content with just making and playing music, Will founded [l=Enhanced Recordings], also in 2005. Now regarded as one of the leading imprints of the scene, Will has amassed a group of wonderful young talent and more established artists to create a label with consistent high quality and a forward thinking approach to the direction of the music today. Little over three years later, the label has spawned 4 sub labels; [l=Enhanced Progressive], [l=Enhanced Limited], [l=Enhanced Black] and [l=Enhanced Digital], as well as 3 stand out compilations and is now within touching distance of the magic 50 mark. With consistent support from the world’s dj’ing elite, regular appearances on the largest compilations and substantial ‘Tune of the …’ accolades from the key magazines and radio shows, the label that has ‘gained a lot of respect in a short space of time’ (I-DT Magazine, NL) has been making ‘a good case for its position at the head of the UK trance table’ (Mixmag) and is now ‘one of the most famous trance labels today’ ([a=Armin van Buuren] - ASOT). Band.Name: Taleamus
Band.BandBiographyText:
Taleamus, real name Marko Sirén, started his music career in the early 2000s as he got interested in making electronic music. At that time Marko made music just for fun and mostly for his friends, so his audience was not that large.

Marko got more knowledge of computer music software and in 2004 he started to make music more seriously. He met new people who gave him good tips and tricks to make better music. In 2004 Marko's most impressive production was In Your Ice, which however did not gain much popularity but it was a good start.

Marko made a lot of experiments, and step by step found his own style and sound. In summer 2005 he finally decided to launch a new music project, Taleamus. Taleamus came up with for example a new progressive remix of In Your Ice which also gained some popularity on Internet radio stations and podcasts. So In Your Ice was a good start also for Taleamus' career, and it made Marko to believe that he can do something more in music business.

Taleamus had found his style and produced more and more tunes such as Epic Lullaby, Amore and Melanthius in 2006. Taleamus was also building connections with DJs and other music producers on social network sites on the Internet.

The year 2007 was again the time for new In Your Ice remixes because Taleamus organized a remix contest whose aim was to give unsigned or signed artists an opportunity to make their own remix of In Your Ice. The track got a lot of different remixes on the Finnish music site Mikseri.net. Also, of course, it was time for Taleamus make his very own 2007 remix of the track.

2008 was not such a productive year for Taleamus as he had a lot of works to do in his private life. Even though Taleamus did not produce much his own tunes, he concentrated on remixing . He made remixes of two old Russian tunes and also a new remix of his own tune Epic Lullaby. Only one new tune came out and it was called Benevolencia. However, it was never available for download on the Internet. 2008 productions hardly gained any popularity as Taleamus did not spread them freely on the Internet.

The new year 2009 was a new beginning for Taleamus as he and Bluebear Project formed a new trance group called Sinytal. Taleamus also remixed Bluebear Project's tune Nowhere To Go which came out on February 2nd by Blue Trance Records label. Now Taleamus continues producing music with Sinytal but also produces his own tunes for Blue Trance Records.

Band.Name: Ophidian
Band.BandBiographyText:
Using keyboards and cassette recorders Conrad Hoyer started recording his first songs and mixes in 1993, 11 years old at the time. By 1995 hardcore music had become very infuential for the Dutch youth and he started using computer software to write hardcore songs. With the artists of the Ruffneck label as main lead he worked on perfecting his technique, specialising in fast, breakbeat-orriented juno-sound hardcore. In 1998 DJ Ruffneck was convinced of Conrad's talent after recieving a 4 track cd-demo, and asked him if he would like to join his labels Gangsta and Supreme Intelligence. And thus at 16 years old Conrad became the youngest artist to join the crew. The period '98-'00 can be seen as a learning period in which Conrad released a few records as Trypticon and a few more tracks as Ophidian, but was still struggling to be consistent and to find an own place within the hardcore scene.
Things changed in 2001. In this year Conrad joined Enzyme Records, started building his own studio and started his studying Music Technology at the Utrecht School of Arts. He decided to drop the Trypticon-project and concentrate on producing as Ophidian, focussing on slower hardcore, with more techno and electronic music influences. Enzyme started a sub-label called Enzyme X on which more experimental hardcore could be released, which came as a blessing because it provided exactly the space that Conrad needed to define himself and his style. From this moment on progression was fast, and he released quite a number of tracks including his first solo-album, Ophidian - Blackbox, in 2003.
Now Conrad has finished his study and as Bachelor of Music Composition and Production he faces a future in the music bussiness, as a producer mixing and mastering, as DJ and live performer, but still mainly as artist exploring the more experimental areas of hardcore, techno and electronic music.

Thanks to this they got a radio program (conduced by Filippo and his MC), which helped to consolidate their fame in Rome.After Pronto Soccorso they organised also Odissea 2001 another Rave which was hold in the most prestigious location of Rome; La Fiera di Roma! In the meanwhile Filippo produced some Hardcore tracks which were included in the Compilation Traxtorm Power 2000 and Always Hardcore 7.In the summer 2000 Filippo improved the wish to dedicate himself to the production of hardcore tracks. Band.BandBiographyText:
Born in The Hague on the 16th of September 1973, Erwin van Kan started his career back in his infant-years. Jumping on a piano, smashing it, and then falling on a table with his head, leaving a nasty mark on his eyebrow! Maybe his Hardcore-style was already born? :) About 12 years ago, he began spinning music with a tape-recorder and some sort of turntable. Cutted, pasted, and recorded several mix-tapes during that time.
After a couple of years he managed to build his own studio. He bought some equipment, like a small sampler, and he produced several tracks, not released on vinyl, but just for friends... Then, when he spinned as a DJ in a coffeeshop, he managed to produce a demo-tape wich he gave to a friend, who had some connections in the record-business. Then he had the opportunity to release his first record : 'All that she wants' on Bünkor Beats-records. At that time he was booked at several small parties, and some of them were very underground. For some people in his country, they know wich underground-party we mean: The massive 'squat'-party, downtown The Hague! With lots of other DJ's like Virus, the english DJ Raw (not the mc), and many more... 
Myztic (Nosferatu's first DJ-name) spinned for over 7 hours non-stop that night! After several years of working (more as a DJ, than a producer) he bought some new equipment and made a new demo. One day Ruffneck was performing at a party, and Nosferatu gave his demo to him. Then his career really started; he got an appointment with Ruffneck and he became part of a great recordcompany! 'Inspiration vibes', 'Dangerous Battle', and many more were made by the hand of Nosferatu.
Now, together with Endymion he runs the Enzyme label. The tracks on Enzyme can be heared on many parties throughout the world, played by many respected DJ's. Nosferatu will continue to produce Hardcore and he can be seen on many parties as a DJ, representing the vicious Enzyme-virus... "Respect the people who want to live their life, like they want it to live"

Band.Name: Hamunaptra
Band.BandBiographyText:
Born in Harlingen (Holland) on 08-09-1978 Rienk Bauritius started to grow a special interest in music, he learned how to play several brasilian percussian instruments (his mother is from Brasil) and learned how to play guitar. 
His interest in house music dates from back in the late 80's, he started taping music from different illegal "radio pirates" and tried to cut n paste the tapes into "mixes", which never really worked by the way 
Later on he's love for house music expanded when he first saw guys like "The Nightraver, Ruffneck, Neophtye, Reanimator" etc. perform at big raves in the early 90's where he started to go at with only 13 years of age.
 
Several years later he started to learn how to spin records and bought equipment to make his own music. Helped and pushed by "DJ Akira" ,who helped him to get together with people behind several big record labels, he sent a tape with a few tracks to "Supreme Intelligence" and after a few "annoying" phone calls, trying to get them to listen to the tape as soon as possible, he signed up with "S.I.N./Gangsta" just 2 weeks later. The tracks he sent them were never released by the way, this because of a computer crash, that way he lost all the samples and arrangements of his tracks.
 
When later on "Supreme Intelligence/Gangsta" stopped and "Enzyme Records" started he took off with them releasing his tracks at a fast rate, playing on party's worldwide and he is one of the participants in the new Enzyme live act "Enzyme Elite". He isn’t going to stop just yet and you surely will hear more from this guy in the near future.

Band.Name: Art Of Fighters

Alias.@AliasProfile: Meccano Twins started out back in 2003, originally born as a side project of Art Of Fighters.  The idea behind was to create a different breed of hardcore, bleeding the mainstream style together with darkcore and more underground electronic music, without losing the vibe and power of the standard hardcore music.

Band.BandBiographyText:
Art of Fighters started out in Brescia (Italy) in 1997, from the idea of 3 guys: Cristian Nardelli, Matteo Pitossi and Luca Lorini.

Thanks to FastTracker, 3 years of try-outs, tons of rejected tracks and the big help of the Stunned Guys, the first record The Beat Can't Change came to life in the year 2000. In 2001 their second E.P. Artwork appeared in the stores, definately putting them on the map of hardcore. Their tracks appeared on many compilations and their fame began to expand.

In the end of 2002 they decided to switch FastTracker for some more professional equip-ment: a few months after that, Earthquake was released. It was a big success; the record was played by most of the big names of all the nations. Thanks to this and their amazing live-act, the Art of Fighters were asked to perform on some of the major parties in Europe: Hardcore Nation (IT), Resurreqtion (NL), Hardcore Gladiators (DE), Street Parade (Swiss), Masters of Hardcore (IT), Evolution (Swiss), SummerRave (Spain), Rave The Universe (IT), Death Experience (Austria), Goliath (Swiss), Navigator (NL) and Hard Halloween (Spain).

In 2003 they showed their experimental side with a new project named Meccano Twins. The first release was an instant hit and confirmed them as talented producers with a well-appreciated style, especially in Holland.

Just published but already played a lot is the latest work of this Italian trio: Game Don't Stop. And this is only the beginning...

Band.Name: Mega Meisseli
Band.BandBiographyText:
Ilona Rinnemaa, better known as Mega Meisseli, is a Finnish psytrance artist. She was born on September 11, 1981, in Finland. Mega Meisseli's music is rooted in the Finnish Suomisaundi style of psytrance.

Mega Meisseli's music is characterized by its fast tempo and hard-hitting basslines. It is often said to be "full-on" psytrance. Mega Meisseli is known for her energetic live performances, which often feature LED lights and laser shows.

In recent years, Mega Meisseli has been working on expanding her sound, incorporating elements of techno and house into her music. She has released two albums, "Dance of the spirits" (2013) and "Empire of the Sun" (2017). Mega Meisseli is one of the most internationally-known psytrance artists from Finland.

Mega Meisseli's work has been praised for its originality and for its ability to bring the Suomisaundi sound to a global audience.

Band.Name: DJ Sanna V

Finnish psytrance artist DJ Sanna V (Sanna Vääräniemi) has been spinning her signature brand of hard-hitting, high-energy trance music for over a decade.

A native of Finland, Sanna began her DJ career while still in her teens, quickly making a name for herself on the local club circuit. She soon began touring internationally, playing at some of the biggest psytrance festivals in the world.

Over the years, Sanna has continued to evolve her sound, incorporating elements of techno, house, and even pop into her dynamic DJ sets. She’s also a talented producer, having released a number of well-received tracks on leading psytrance labels.

Sanna is a true pioneer of Finnish psytrance, and her innovative style has helped to make her one of the most popular DJs in the scene. With her high-octane sets and unbridled energy, she always leaves her fans wanting more.

Band.Name: DJ Mortti
Band.BandBiographyText:
DJ Mortti, a trailblazing figure in the world of electronic music, was brought into existence on February 16, 1981, under the star sign of Aquarius. Known for her captivating performances and innovative productions, DJ Mortti is the moniker of Elisa Hannula, a Finnish DJ and producer who has significantly contributed to the genre of Finnish Psytrance and Suomisaundi.

Born in Finland, DJ Mortti's passion for music began at an early age. She honed her skills as a DJ and producer, quickly gaining recognition within the local scene for her unique style and energetic performances. Her music is characterized by its intricate melodies, powerful beats, and a distinct Finnish flair that sets it apart from other psytrance artists.

DJ Mortti's journey in the music industry has been marked by a relentless pursuit of excellence and a deep love for her craft. She has performed at numerous prestigious events across Finland and beyond, sharing the stage with some of the biggest names in the psytrance scene. Her music is a testament to her dedication, creativity, and unwavering commitment to her art.

As DJ Mortti continues to evolve and push boundaries, she remains firmly rooted in her Finnish heritage, embracing the Suomisaundi tradition while infusing it with her own innovative spirit. Her music is a celebration of Finnish culture and a testament to the power of electronic music to transcend borders and unite people. DJ Mortti's story is one of passion, perseverance, and the transformative power of music.

Band.Name: Fleeticer
Band.BandBiographyText:
Jarkko Saikkonen aka Fleeticer, born in 1988, is a new rising and promising trance producer from Finland. He got into the electronic music genre in the 90’s when eurodance was blooming, but he didn’t start producing until the early 2000’s. For the first few years he produced different kind of electronic music styles, but then he realised trance was “the thing”. The artist name “Fleeticer” was born and from there trance has stayed as his main genre.

His productions are mostly uplifting trance, but sometimes you might hear him turn the direction for awhile, yet returning back to uplifting again. The main thing is to keep the drive, feeling and great sounds in his productions, giving a good experience for those who just like to relax, sit back and listen, and for those who want more thrill.

Fleeticer will keep bringing you the driving and uplifting stuff you’ve heard so far. So stay tuned and keep your eye on this one.

Band.Name: Atmotion
Band.BandBiographyText: Atmotion aka Mika Lindgrén, 24 years old guy from Hämeenlinna, Finland. He started making music in the year 2000 with a program called Madtracker. With very little knowledge in producing, time passed by quickly just experimenting with different sounds and loops. Much later Fruity Loops was introduced and even now it's one of the most valuable tools in his software arsenal.

Band.Name: Se.Ra.Phic
Band.BandBiographyText:
Se.Ra.Phic (Rocco Rago) was born in 1985 and lives in Trebisacce, a small town in the south of Italy. He was inspired to start producing music after a trip to Germany.

After a few years learning production tricks, and inspired by his girlfriend, Se.Ra.Phic is signed up by Emotive Sounds after sending his first demo “I live in your eyes”, track that goes straight into Audiojelly’s top 10.Two months after the release of his debut single his 1st remix of Saint Rush's "Sovereign" is released.

Regarding his musical influences, Se.Ra.Phic says “I started listening to trance around 1998, and love the old trance style. For me the Trance must be an explosion of emotion. My best producer is Ace Da Brain, probably the best!"

Her journey in the music industry began in 2002 when she decided to pursue her passion for creating original, exciting, and riveting music. Jenni chose the pseudonym 'Jennifer Current' to signify her continuous evolution as an artist, keeping up with the current times and trends while maintaining her quintessential Finnish style and authenticity.

The genre of Psytrance is known for its high-energy electronic beats and complexity, and it is in this genre that Jennifer Current truly shines. Virtanen's music also falls under the umbrella of Suomisaundi, a sub-genre of psytrance that originated in Finland. Suomisaundi, also known as "Finnish sound", is known for its free-form and often quirky style. Virtanen has been able to carve out a unique sound within these genres that reflect her artistic personality.

Jennifer Current's pulsating beats, combined with eccentric melodies are a psychedelic journey into the depths of consciousness, providing not just music but a unique experience to her listeners. Over the years, Virtanen's music, under the moniker 'Jennifer Current', has reached international acclaim solidifying her as a staple artist in the Psytrance community. With her consistent dedication to her craft, Jennifer Current is a vibrant example of the pulsating Psytrance and Suomisaundi scene not just in Finland, but worldwide.

Despite her success, Jenni remains humble, continually learning and pushing the boundaries of her art. She is a testament to the global reach of Finnish electronic music and an ambassador for underground Psytrance and Suomisaundi movement. A true virtuoso, her commitment to creating music that pushes boundaries while respecting the traditions of her chosen genres has paved the way for an exceptional career that continues to inspire and engage fans across the globe.

Band.Name: Arsehole Audio
Band.BandBiographyText:
Arsehole Audio, a moniker that stands as a testament to the unique and unconventional nature of its creator, is a prominent figure in the realm of Finnish Psytrace music. Born on the 5th day of May, 1985, Antti Lindström brings a fresh and innovative perspective to the genre, commonly known as Suomisaundi within his native Finland.

Antti's journey into the world of music production began in the late 90s, where he was captivated by the pulsating rhythms and hypnotic melodies that defined the emerging Finnish Psytrance scene. Fueled by an insatiable passion for electronic music, Lindström honed his skills as a DJ and producer, tirelessly experimenting with sounds and styles that would eventually define his signature sound under the alias Arsehole Audio.

In the years since, Antti's work has evolved to become synonymous with Finnish Psytrance, a genre that showcases the raw energy and unbridled creativity of Finland's vibrant electronic music scene. Arsehole Audio's productions are characterized by intricate melodies, powerful basslines, and a relentless drive that leaves dancers breathless on the dance floor.

With a discography that spans over a decade and includes numerous releases on respected Finnish labels, Antti Lindström continues to push the boundaries of Psytrance music. His live performances are legendary, as he seamlessly blends traditional Finnish Psytrance with contemporary influences to create an unforgettable auditory experience.

As Arsehole Audio, Antti Lindström stands as a beacon of innovation and creativity within the Finnish electronic music scene. His dedication to his craft and commitment to pushing the boundaries of what is possible in Psytrance music makes him a true artist to watch in the years to come.

Band.Name: Ace Da Brain
Band.BandBiographyText:
Andreas Schmidt was born 1976 in a small town next to Frankfurt. He visited elementary school in Germany but then moved on to international schools in Bangkok and New Delhi. After the A-Levels graduation (Abitur) he did one's military service in a special forces unit. Right after that he went to university.

The different countries, their lifestyles and cultures influenced him a lot. There he learned the musical basics as well as the technical (computer) abilities for his further, to that time still unknown future. 


In the year 1998 he met Marcus. They shared their interest for techno and with Ace's producing abilities and Marcus' djing skills they founded Marc & Ace or Marc la Cruz & Ace da Brain.


From that time on Ace invented many project names and produced a wide range of tracks with Marcus as a Dj on his side. Projects like Airfire, Traveller or Sonic Inc. were born and were very well received from many Dj's and Fans all around the world.


Early 2003 the business partnership of Marc & Ace ended as well as the negotiations with George Acosta for who's releases he was responsible for since "Emotions" (year 2000). Ace founded his own label "Venom Recordings" and his own Publishing company "ACEAGE-Musikverlag" to continue business a more professional way.

With a passion for music that ignites every note she plays, Bianca's unique blend of traditional Finnish melodies and electronic beats creates a soundscape that is undeniably her own. Her journey began with the pulsating rhythms of psytrance, a genre where she found an outlet to express her love for music and her cultural roots.

Bianca's music is more than just a melody; it's an emotional journey that takes listeners on a trip through the rich landscapes of Finland, blending traditional instrumentation with modern electronic sounds. Her performances are a testament to her dedication, skill, and unwavering commitment to pushing the boundaries of what Finnish music can be.

As a member of various bands throughout her career, Bianca has shared the stage with some of Finland's most respected musicians. However, it is in her solo work that she truly shines, creating music that resonates deeply with audiences around the world.

When not performing or composing, Katja Simonen, aka Bianca, can often be found exploring the wild beauty of Finland's forests and lakes, drawing inspiration from the natural world that has shaped her music and her spirit. Her music is more than just a reflection of her country; it is a tribute to its soul.

In the ever-evolving world of electronic music, Bianca stands out as a beacon of Finnish talent, pushing boundaries and redefining what it means to create psychedelic trance music from the heart of Finland. Her journey continues, and we are all invited to join her on this exciting musical adventure.

Band.BandBiographyText:
Bianca is a dynamic and innovative musical duo hailing from the heart of Finland, known for their unique blend of Finnish Psytrance and Suomisaundi genres. The core members of this creative force are Katja Simonen, born on November 7th, 1985, who takes charge as both the vocalist and producer.

Bianca's sound is a captivating fusion of traditional Finnish rhythms with the pulsating beats of psytrance, creating a sonic landscape that is both familiar and extraordinary. As Bianca continues to evolve and push the boundaries of their sound, they remain dedicated to the artistry and creativity that has defined their journey thus far. With each new release, they continue to captivate listeners with their unique blend of musical styles, leaving a lasting impression on the Finnish music scene and beyond.

Band.Name: Airwave
Band.BandBiographyText:
Laurent a.k.a. Airwave lived in Brussels until he was 20 years young, experimenting with computers and synthesizers at his home. After sending his first demo to Lightning Records - the home of the Bonzai label - , he became one of the artists of the new age in electronic music. After the first small success with PLG, North Pole, Montera and Magnetix he had his first breakthrough with the first release of Fire & Ice. He decided to move to Antwerp to concentrate on his productional work. The first results were new releases for Fire & Ice, Planisphere and Meridian. After that he evolved more & more to become a real professional artist by producing both Airwave and Body-Shock. All that together with the launch of Bonzai UK made him an instant star in te progressive and trance scene. Besides all that he was also commissioned to make remixes for Yves Deruyter, Da Hool, Aurora, Solar Stone, Blue Alphabet,... Laurent has always essentially been influenced by the roots of electronic music, since the early beginning : from Kraftwerk to FSOL. Great producers as Jarre, Orbital, Oliver Lieb, BT,... are still taking his breath away. He defines his music as "pure electronic dance music" which is a result of many years of discovering and getting inspired by his music heroes, whom he calls "the gods of technology"...

Band.Name: Hellfish
Band.BandBiographyText: "Owner of Deathchant records and beat master extrordinaire Hellfish has produced some of the most amazing futuristic dance music of the last few years. It's easy enough to make abstract bollocks but the dancefloor requires a little more production nous & understanding of the dancefloor. Combining this with abstract bollox (which he surely does) is a most difficult trick. He cut his production teeth back in the day with releases on Moving Shadow, Dance Bass and his own Bogwoppa records. (Let's forget about the happy hardcore years) which brings us up to '96 when he launched Deathchant & pioneered the hardcore techno vs hip-hop sound in a way even now few can match. Just buy ZIQ023:Constant Mutation or listen to the mp3's to be convinced this is Hardcore, for real. The sound of Aphex circa "Quoth" + Aphex circa "Come to daddy" multiplied by old skool Hip-hop with a side serving of Squarepusher to go. Sorry." and this is only the beginning.

Band.Name: Phil Cogan
Band.BandBiographyText:
GOOD Producers, like policemen, get younger and younger these days, and at the grand old age of 27, Phil Cogan is already a veteran of the scene, co- running one of the North East's most successful hard dance nights(Cause & Effect), releasing tracks on labels like Flashpoint, 12 Inch Thumpers, Do Not Bend and setting up his own recording label to celebrate his chosen musical genre.

Phil first got into dance music in the early 90s, listening to hardcore tapes from the notorious North East of England hardcore scene. After been given his first sampler aged just 13, followed by decks at 15, he began mixing Scottish hardcore in his bedroom.

Over the years Phil has played along side some of the biggest DJ’s on the hard house scene including, Paul Maddox, Anna Savage, Tara Reynolds, Ed Real the list goes on. While playing out Phil has found himself djing in various locations over the years from barn party’s to packed out clubs across the country.

While in the studio Phil has worked along side Paul Maddox, Eufex and Graeme EUK. Having remixed tracks for the likes of Lisa Pin Up and having his own material remixed by players such as Rodi Style, Paul Maddox and Dave Owens.

Between Djing and production Phil is a regular co presenter and guest on the cause & effect radio show. Playing out a lot of new unreleased tracks and digging out some forgotten classics.

Now releasing all of his own material on his label First Class Recordings Phil is able to control how and when the music will be released. With a heavy schedule of one release a month followed by a remix of each track Phil is making sure that everyone is kept happy.

Band.Name: DJ D
Band.BandBiographyText: He started his music career as an hardcore Dj producer when he was only 16 years old. He made (now too!) his music only with an simple PC, not anymore! The story of Hardcore Blasters label is deeply attached to Dj D's, since the label was born after he gave (1999) a tape demo to Simone (chairman!) and he like it. Of course the first demo was not released on vinyl (however insert on Jump vol.1 compilation), but with this one , DJ D career could have to start! During 2000 Dj D try to improve the sound quality of his products, so in November 2000 , with his friend Luca Morlini (Dj Lux) performed his first record DJ D vs DJ LUX "Inside myself E.P." and Hardcore Blasters label started to moved! Through the years he improved his sound quality level, performing some remixes for some djs! Hits like "Original Style" DJ D remix was been included into several hardcore compilations and played by some famous Djs like Promo,Endymion,Nosferatu. During the 2002, he started to develop his own unique style of production which resulted in his first 10" record called "X-ploration" which was released in June 2002. "Mankind warning" was the hit-track played by several djs like Endymion & Nosferatu in some parties! It was included in several important hardcore compilation like MOH, Always Hardcore,Hardcore Ressuretion and many other... So after this project, Dj D performed a remix of "Getting High" for Ferox released on Bionic records, for The Blaster, B 747 & Angels of Darkness. Together with Valentino Oliviero (The Blaster), he became PSYCHORUDES and he is 50% of Angels of Darkness & Noize Creator too! Nowadays DJ D is working-hard to experiment new sounds dimensions... And he has just planned a collaboration with Endymion on Enzyme label! So there is more to come...

He started to produce about 4 or 5 years ago when he bought my first PC. He gave his first demo tracks to Randy and a few months later the record "Atomic Burst E.P." came out... After this he met Pietro from ANGELS OF DARKNESS, and gave to him a demo. Simone (the owner of HC Blasters) liked all the tracks... his new releases were born…so let's start with Hardcore Blasters!! He performed with a live act into several parties. Together with Diego (Dj D), he became Psychorudes. Another nickname he use is The Insane Animal (last release Hm2720).

When he in these last year he bought a PC and Started to make some traxx and then in 2002 he send his demo cd to the Hardcore Blasters. So his tracks was good and has been released in his first E.P (Hm2722 - Hellsystem). To make his tracks he use only an simple Pc without any other instuments.

Band.Name: The Viper
Band.BandBiographyText:
The story of Dutch Hardcore Deejay "The Viper" kicked off in 1988 when he bought his first set of turntables. In the beginning it was all about Hip Hop, New Jack Swing, the scratching and the skills, but after a while he discovered his true passion in playing house music. The tricks and the skills stayed, the music he played became harder and harder.

A new deejay was born, and because of his love for the car and the snake he called himself "The Viper". Success never comes easy, so he had to work his way up. The first years he started proving himself in the smaller clubs. After a while more and more people spotted his talent witch resulted in gigs at huge raves like "Thunderdome" and "Mysteryland". Pretty soon "The Viper" became one of the big names that pushed the hardcore scene forward.

Not only inside, but also far out of the borders of Holland in countries like Spain, Switzerland,Italy and the U.S.A.

In the year '96 he started producing as well. His first record, called "The Beat", came out on the infamous "Samurai Records". The Viper was able to take his production skills to the highest level and every new release became an instant party hit. Several successful collaborations followed with top Dutch hardcore deejays and producers such as DJ Isaac (Freak That Shit, The Real Shit, Funky Beats, Trigga Finga etc), G-Town Madness, Mad-E-Fact (Control the party, The beatz the suckers wish they had etc) and Dj Attic & Stylzz. Friendships were born and classics were made.

Still reinventing hardcore techno and still blasting his beats all over the world, the story of DJ The Viper continues... [Generated by DBX]

Alias.@AliasProfile: DJ and producer since the 1990's. After his early releases on Babyboom Records, The Viper started his own label Viper Beatz in 2006. He subsequently joined Neophyte Records in 2011. The Viper has played DJ sets at events such as Decibel, Thunderdome, Masters of Hardcore and Defqon.1 and also toured internationally.

Band.Name: DJ Activator
Band.BandBiographyText:
DJ Activator aka Manuel Tessarollo was born in Bassano del Grappa (VI),Italy. His career as a DJ began in the summer of 1995, Early in his career he started as a resident DJ at J&J-Orbital(Fe),Italy. For the following 5 years Manuel performed as a special guest on some major events and clubs in the north east of Italy like: Fabula, Strauss Tour, Sonar, Under Construction, Energy Club, Ecu and Fuse.

At the end of 2000 Manuel decided to focus all his time and energy on what he loves to do best; producing his own music.He produced many tracks which were released under many different pseudonyms. When he first started producing he collaborated with his friend and collegue Roberto Fellini(Rishni) and after much success with him he decided to build his own studio called “Oldbridge” in Bassano del Grappa.

In December 2002, the artist name DJ Activator was born when Manuel sent 2 banging tracks to one of the Italy’s hottest labels called “Activa Records”(Edinet Publishing Group). At that time he needed an appropriate artist pseudonym for that label and the inspiration was immediate, what could be better than Activator?

At the moment DJ Activator is the A&R for Edinet and he’s planning all the releases of these labels:Activa, Explosive, Kattiva, Fuck off, Akustika, Dsl. Since the beginning of his production career he created a lot of famous aliases like: Outlaw, Prozact, Megaphone, Ultrasonic, Spy-Kore, Overdrive, Knockout, T-78, Manuel Es and of course Activator.

He was one of the originators from Italy who contributed making hardstyle famous in the world, due to his massive productions and powerfull DJ sets played in several big clubs around the globe such as Matrixx (NL), Metropolis(F), Oxa (CH),Bionic (UK),ZAK (D) etc.) and big hardstyle events like: Defqon1, Q-Base, Xqlusive, Hardbass, Decibel, Strike One and so many more.

Nowadays, DJ Activator is really satisfied with his job, but is still working hard everyday to make himself better and better to keep his sound underground and original as possible but mainstream at the same time. Overall his main purpose is to be loved by fans for his own music and spread it all around the world!

Band.Name: Paul Elstak
Band.BandBiographyText:
DJ Paul Elstak (real name: Paul Roger Elstak; born The Hague 14 January 1966) is a Dutch hardcore and happy hardcore DJ and record producer. He used to use his full name to create happy hardcore and DJ Paul for hardcore gabber, but when he started Offensive Records in 2001, he started using both names for gabber.

In 1987, his career was launched when he was accepted as a DJ at Rotterdam Discothèque Bluetiek-Inn. Here, for the first time, he played with the Dutch House music pioneer Peter Slaghuis. Around this time he also hooked up with Rob Fabrie and Richard van Naamen to form Holy Noise, with whom he released a string of releases at the Hithouse record label (owned by Slaghuis). In 1991 Holy Noise had their biggest success with their release James Brown is Still Alive. This release was an "answer" to the popular house record James Brown is Dead by L.A. Style. In 1992 he created his own record label, Rotterdam Records (under the flag of Mid-Town records) to release hardcore and Rotterdam Tekno.

The first release on this label was a Holy Noise release under the guise of De Euromasters, releasing Amsterdam Waar Lech Dat Dan? (Translated; Where is Amsterdam?). This record was an answer to the Dutch media always paying attention to Amsterdam but not to Rotterdam. After a lot of releases under different names in 1995 he released the first DJ Paul Elstak single, Life Is Like a Dance. It had great commercial success. After this record, a few commercial releases followed. Rainbow in the Sky is most likely the most successful of these. After 2 years, Elstak decided to quit the commercial dance scene and devote his time releasing gabber. In 2001 he left midtown (and thus also Rotterdam Records) to start a new record label at Rige Entertainment, called Offensive Records. To this day Paul still releases hardcore on this imprint in his own typical (Rotterdam) style.
